ns2:course.label: Macroeconomic Policy
ns2:course.description: Analyzes current macroeconomic policy issues, problems, and techniques; discusses various policy techniques including monetary, fiscal, incomes, and exchange rate policies, and their effectiveness for treating inflation, unemployment, productivity, resource and exchange rate problems. May emphasize current issues in developed economies or in emerging market economies. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECON 303 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ECON 303 or equivalent.
